fullPassage: The above graph shows how often German children and young adults read books in 2022 according to age groups. ①In each age group except 12 to 13-year-olds, those who said they read books once a month or less accounted for the largest proportion. ②Of the 12 to 13-year-old group, 42% stated they read daily or several times a week, which was the highest share within that group. ③In the 14 to 15-year-old group, the percentage of teenagers who read daily or several times a week was three times higher than that of those who never read a book in the same age group. ④In the 16 to 17-year-old group, those who read between once a week and once every two weeks were less than 20%. ⑤More than one fifth of the age group of 18 to 19 years responded that they never read any book.
